claim_type: zero-free interval classification fragment with extremal chromatic-root witness
limitations: Heilmann-Lieb interlacing is supporting evidence for path-backbone matching polynomials, not a claim that the signed chromatic polynomials are real-rooted.
The sharp uniform barrier statement is the all-n claim; finite Sturm tables are checks rather than its proof.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent mathematical assessment completed.
record_title: Uniform real zero-free half-line [3,infinity), sharp barrier 2, for signed-K4 subdivision chromatic polynomials
